observedRuntime.signatureCause: Canonical generic e-signature audit storage is contained; the scheduled expiry job answers 501. Approved-letter signing and evidence sealing are separate required base capabilities.
observedRuntime.mailCause: The existing configured sender credential returns 401 restricted_api_key for a receipt read; no delivery or inbox claim is made.

sourceRemediation.workerScope: The scheduled job manifest owns active base cadences for both infrastructure and runtime monitoring; all five active worker limits remain enforced.
sourceRemediation.genericSignatureStagingJob: Retain the existing job and execution history with a manual trigger; no storage authority or generic signature implementation added.
sourceRemediation.mailSenderAuthentication: Use the existing send-only RESEND_API_KEY for a deliberately empty-recipient sending API request. Accept only the qualified 422 missing_required_field rejection without a message id. This checks sender API authentication only; delivery and human inbox receipt remain required separate final release proofs.
sourceRemediation.credentialProvisioning: Existing staging Key Vault reference retained; direct Azure CLI discovery found no receipt-reading key. No new credential, permission or owner setup required.
sourceRemediation.requestIdentity: Bind and read the verified actor profile before opening a canonical tenant transaction; reuse its callback-scoped authority for evidence sealing and nested authorization, retaining actor/organization/role checks and post-return expiry.
sourceRemediation.authWaitBounds: Install transaction-local 5-second lock and 15-second statement limits on the dedicated auth executor, preserving roles and pool sizes.

ownedTestPrerequisite.note: This is controlled technical QA admission; it is not customer adoption or commercial license evidence.

previousDraftFastSuite.failure: Undeclared optional receipt-reading credential; the new credential has been removed, not exempted or given a larger drift ceiling.

observedRequestFailure.cause: A case transaction held its principal advisory lock and requested a second auth bridge through evidence sealing; the auth pool waited on that same principal while the runtime transaction waited on auth.
observedRequestFailure.recovery: Cancelled only the exactly identified blocked synthetic auth query; the request rolled back. Original committed claims, audit and evidence digests were unchanged. No backend was terminated and no live data, roles, ACLs or schema were reset.
